RMSSD-based HRV in [20, 80] ms is approximately symmetric within person and captured well by gaussian/identity at this person's scale.

Daily Apple Exercise Time is zero-inflated on rest days but otherwise approximately exponential. Gaussian/identity is the pragmatic choice and the compiler tolerates the zero mass; gamma/log would reject the 0-min entries.

0-4 continuous severity rating from journal entry text.
